text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki won the Mainichi Hai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She felt that Oguri Cap's calm, effortless 
running style was the complete opposite of 
her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved a stellar run and result, 
Yaeno Muteki's next goal is the Satsuki 
Sho. The Classic Triple Crown races are 
finally here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However—her generational rival, Mejiro 
Ardan, was forced to skip the Satsuki Sho. 
It seems the condition of her legs isn't 
looking good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, what must be done remained 
unchanged. Yaeno Muteki declared war on 
Sakura Chiyono O, vowing to win the 
Satsuki Sho.
